model: jsdom + fake-indexeddb; direct handler calls, modeled source dialog and mocked fetch, accelerated timeout; no real network or geometry
checks: restore blocks all three input entry points
text success, empty/invalid rejection and cancel preserve current graph
text size limit counts UTF-8 bytes, retaining oversized multibyte input
raw Markdown view is readonly and direct submit cannot mutate the source
Escape closes text entry while retaining draft input and existing graph
InfoBar dismissal preserves graph; Drawer toggle updates visibility and aria state
HTTPS URL import and update use anonymous no-referrer CORS requests
empty/non-HTTPS/credential-bearing URLs are rejected before network
URL HTML content type preserves existing graph and permits retry
URL HTML disguised as plain text preserves existing graph and permits retry
URL invalid Markdown preserves existing graph and permits retry
URL HTTP failure preserves existing graph and permits retry
URL network/CORS failure preserves existing graph and permits retry
URL oversized Content-Length preserves existing graph and permits retry
URL oversized streamed body preserves existing graph and permits retry
URL failed update retains old graph and subsequent retry succeeds
duplicate URL submission is blocked and cancel discards a late response
switching URL entry to text discards stale URL completion
duplicate URL refresh is blocked and closing its tab discards late result
30-second URL timeout aborts request and leaves input retryable (accelerated timer model)
file/URL/text originals and source bodies restore from IndexedDB without automatic network access
structuredClone persistence failure is an error alert and preserves current graph
saveSession rejection is an error alert and preserves current graph
invalid persisted session restores no graph, announces error and leaves inputs usable
text and URL Markdown keep script/image/link payloads inert
